news.title: Thomas Tuchel's Trent Alexander-Arnold treatment reveals England fear that led to World Cup failure
news.lede: How do you solve a problem like Trent Alexander-Arnold? To start with, it’s probably best to acknowledge that there might not be that much of a problem at all. The England and Real Madrid defender/midfielder/playmaker/nobody-quite-knows-what-er made his first start under Thomas Tuchel against Czechia on Tuesday and proved the difference in creating the first goal to break down a stubborn defence just after half-time. Trent, as he likes to be called these days, has always confused England fans and pundits alike.

news.title: Erling Haaland sues Norwegian Air over World Cup ad featuring his ponytail
news.lede: Norway football star Erling Haaland has taken legal action against Norwegian Air Shuttle, alleging that the airline used elements of his appearance without permission in a World Cup advertisement. The dispute centres on a social media post released during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, when Norway made its first appearance at the tournament since 1998. According to Norwegian newspaper Verdens Gang (VG), the airline shared a composite image of one of its aircraft featuring a ponytail resembling Haaland's distinctive hairstyle. The post carried the caption, "We've never looked more Norwegian," referencing the national team's World Cup campaign.

news.title: Nigeria's Special Eagles prep for 2026 Amputee World Cup
news.lede: Nigeria amputee football team training. Picture: Marabou News Agency. Nigeria's men's national amputee football team, known as the Special Eagles, is hard at work in Abuja as they prepare for the 2026 Amputee World Cup. The Major tournament will take place in San Juan De Los Lagos, Mexico, running from November 13 to 22.

news.title: Lionel Messi retires from international football
news.lede: Having started playing football in his native Argentina, Lionel Messi joined Barcelona's youth academy in 2001 at the age of 13. It wasn't long before he was promoted to the first team, making his La Liga debut in October 2004 at the age of 17. The following May he scored his first goal. His first title also came in his debut season, as Barcelona won La Liga in 2004-05.
